semantic_verdict.summary: The full deck has a readable high-level emotional arc and all seven assets are exact 1080x1440 Instagram-post rasters with one correct top-right brandmark each. It cannot pass Event B. Slide 4 drops the locked curly quotation marks. Slides 1, 3, 5, and 6 contain unauthorized readable signs, menus, labels, badges, packaging, or plate text. Slides 1, 3, and 6 contain unauthorized background people or human-shaped silhouettes, with slide 3 also carrying an unresolved car-window figure. The same car, divided-road setting, intended restaurant, and chai stall do not remain continuous. Slide 5 weakens the intended gaze-led attention turn. Slide 6 adds a second live chai glass and an extra focal hand, contradicting the drink-ownership action. Slide 7 preserves a joint same-door check but fails plausible latch-edge geometry and fails the outward-U-return route required to prove 'went back.'
semantic_verdict.weakest_frame: Slide 7 is the primary scene-logic failure because the exact payoff depends on a visible return path and physically plausible latch interaction; slide 6 is the next strongest semantic contradiction because the second live chai glass cancels the intended steal/share action.
